figurative_meaning_en: to touch or come into contact
example_sentences_in_bangla: বইটিতে হাত পড়ল না, এখনও অপড়।
ফলের বাগানে হাত পড়লে ক্ষতি হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: I didn't lay a hand on the book; it's still unread.
If you touch the orchard, it will get damaged.
note: This idiom often implies initial contact or starting to handle something, with a connotation of potential change or damage.
